label: Tournament Access
description: Whitelist / join gate for tournament matches — restricts who can join based on a tournament roster.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns the tournament join-gate on or off.

cvars.label: Tournament ID
cvars.description: ID of the tournament whose roster gates access to this server.

cvars.label: Bypass Permission
cvars.description: Minimum minqlx permission level that bypasses the roster gate.

cvars.label: Dev Auth Open
cvars.description: Disables the roster gate entirely for local/dev testing.
